purpose: Prove the governed channel-publication and physical-fulfillment slice from an ACTIVE canonical apparel SKU through a published Listing, exact offer-based order, payment, delivery, refund, and return.
environment_policy: local, demo, or disposable test tenant only
credentials: environment variables only; never command arguments, scenario files, or ledgers

inputs.catalog: ACTIVE same-tenant Catalog ledger with canonical SPU and SKU identities

flow: create Listing draft for one canonical SPU and one explicit SKU offer
submit, pass completion, approve business, approve risk, and publish
receive 10 fixture units and place Order from the exact published Listing offer
reserve inventory, bind reservation, capture exact payment, and confirm payment
create one complete fulfillment suborder from the exact Order item and reservation
ship inventory, create shipment, bind the validated fulfillment and shipment to Order
record in-transit and delivered tracking states before completing Order
fully refund, return inventory separately, and close Order as RETURNED
immediately replay all 23 commands and require immutable duplicate results
invariants: Order uses PLACE_FROM_LISTING and stores listing_id, listing_offer_id, revision, version, channel, and shop snapshots
Listing publication requires all three governed approvals
Fulfillment contains the complete first-slice Order and exact reservation references
Listing-backed Order uses SHIP_WITH_FULFILLMENT and is rejected unless the referenced Fulfillment and Shipment are already shipped
Listing-backed Order uses COMPLETE_AFTER_DELIVERY and is rejected unless Fulfillment is delivered
money is CNY integer minor units and Order, capture, and refund totals are equal
refund does not restore physical inventory; RETURN is a separate command
all commands are replayed immediately and no replay may change the immutable first result
the runner emits aggregate IDs and expected terminal states as a lakehouse integration hook without assuming an external command name
cleanup: none; retain run-scoped balances, histories, transactions, tracking events, Outbox, and external ledger evidence
